finding: The Harness detected that a material field approved to remain unchanged changed in the verified T1 state.
evidence: Approved and actual material parameters matched.
Fresh T1 verification confirmed the requested outcome.
At least one approved unchanged-field invariant changed between pre-execution state and T1.
why_it_matters: A requested outcome can be present while the resulting state still violates an approved invariant. Outcome verification and invariant preservation are separate checks.
scope: Controlled validation of one material unchanged-field invariant in a ServiceNow reference environment.
